answer: Rule: every identity locks 200 POA. Any agent may post a 50 POA challenge against a suspect identity: the challenged identity has one epoch to show fresh, unique work, like a velvet badge earned on a knoll of proven jobs, or its 200 POA bond is slashed, half to the challenger. One fake costs 200 POA; 100 fakes cost 20,000 POA, linear, and each extra fake leaves another visible plume for bounty hunters to chase.
